title: Sickchill
description: SickChill is an automatic Video Library Manager for TV Shows. It watches for new episodes of your favorite shows, and when they are posted it does its magic: automatic torrent/nzb searching, downloading, and processing at the qualities you want. For hardlinked imports, give this app and your download client the same DATA path. In SickChill, use /data/media/tv as the library folder.

parameters.label: SICKCHILL /DATA
parameters.description: Host folder mounted at /data. Use the same path for all your media apps and keep it on one filesystem, with downloads/ and media/ inside it. It must be writable by PUID/PGID.
